title: fix(ui): Android agent browser says tab unavailable after a cold start
body:
Closes #187645

## What Problem This Solves

The embedded Agent browser panel can stay blank after cold navigation even though the agent's browser tab is live. `/focus/browser` passes the exact `fixedTab` and session key but omits that tab from the existing reference list. The intentionally session-filtered Gateway list therefore hides Chrome's reused, untracked startup tab.

## User Impact

The focus page now displays its selected cold-start tab without switching to a different tab. Android embeds this Gateway page; no Android app code changes. Closed/stopped targets remain unavailable.

## Why This Change Was Made

Since #159891, scoped tab lists include tracked tabs plus explicitly referenced tabs. The chat side panel already passes transcript references through `sessionTabs`; `BrowserDocument` must supply its own fixed-tab reference through that same API. Tracking the reused tab instead would incorrectly grant the session cleanup ownership. Retrying or selecting the first remaining tab would violate the exact-tab contract.

This keeps the Gateway's route/profile matching, filtering, permissions, registry and cleanup unchanged. Anmol Bhardwaj's original fix commit is preserved.

## Evidence

[Fresh native runtime proof and request frames](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191538#issuecomment-6605970691) · [all eight inspected screenshots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191538#issuecomment-6605943059)

Built main `d3b571f8163c658feafb327d8699d3485ae1680d` versus exact candidate `4e5e33316c7e64f53b8c7e2dc377a49119b2387e`, each served by its built Gateway in secretless Node 24.22.1 Docker, real Chromium 156.0.8078.79:

| Cold navigate, then exact focus URL | Main | Candidate |
|---|---|---|
| Round 1 | Unavailable; no image | Selected startup tab shown |
| Round 2 | Unavailable; no image | Selected startup tab shown |
| Tracked `open` control | Shows its own tab twice | Shows its own tab twice |
| Close exact target while another remains | No fallback twice | No fallback twice |

### Before

![Main cold startup leaves the exact focus panel unavailable](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/251271d6-7e6b-4b39-92bd-73ad068de460)

### After

![Candidate shows the selected cold startup tab](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9248a4e2-16d1-4277-ab1a-c057b8c54ab4)

Public `/tools/invoke` cold `navigate` reuses the startup tab without `open`; a fresh browser context loads the exact session/host/profile/targetId focus URL. Native UI request frames contain no references on main and the exact selected reference on the candidate. The real Gateway and managed Chromium are not mocked. Only the HTML fixture is synthetic. For stable screenshots, subsequent binary screencast frame delivery is briefly held **after** the actual live image is decoded and visible, then resumed; no RPC, tab list or pixels are replaced. No physical Android handset or live model turn was exercised.

The regression is consolidated into the existing document test, retaining its connection-feedback assertions. The separate 77-line media/setup test is removed; existing route/dashboard cases and the native proof cover stopped/missing targets, exact selection and no other-tab fallback. The consolidated test fails on main's omitted reference. Candidate focused tests: **3 files, 15 passed**. Focused lint/format and both root/UI builds pass.

Whole-PR delta: production **+7/−0**; tests **+17/−20 (net −3)**. No new allocation or ratchet exception.

Merge risk: **two-way door**; a revert fully restores prior behavior without a state/config migration. Blast radius is the referenced tab list of the embedded `/focus/browser` page. If wrong, that page may omit its exact browser preview; chat-side panels, dashboards, tab ownership and Gateway access policy are unchanged.
